Payments for every merchant

Acme Pay builds card payment terminals and online checkout tools for merchants across Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Our team has helped thousands of shops accept payments safely, settle money the next day, and understand their sales with simple reports.

Founded in Cairo, we run a small, focused company. Every product is designed with merchants, tested in real shops, and supported by people who answer the phone. We believe every business deserves clear and fair payments.
